questions.prompt: Check the Cauchy-Riemann equations for \(f(z)=z^2\).

questions.prompt: Check \(f(z)=\overline z\).
questions.answer: Here \(u=x\) and \(v=-y\). Then \(u_x=1\) but \(v_y=-1\). Since \(u_x\ne v_y\), the Cauchy-Riemann equations fail, so \(\overline z\) is not complex differentiable.
